_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::input_format#9 — a FALSIFICATION. The entry said 4C poro keeps the rho*a term even for quasi-static problems, so a step load rings at the elastic wave frequency, and prescribed ramping the load over ten wave traversal times. Upstream poro_2D_quad4_const_material_nodal_orthotropic_permeability.4C.yaml is a genuinely quasi-static poro deck (STRUCTURAL DYNAMIC DYNAMICTYPE Statics, FLUID DYNAMIC TIMEINTEGR Stationary, POROELASTICITY DYNAMIC TRANSIENT_TERMS none): it exits 0 with 3 result tests CORRECT, and multiplying the solid DENS by 1000 (2000 -> 2000000) leaves all 3 CORRECT, none WRONG and the abs(diff) unchanged (SOLID_DENSITY_CHANGED_THE_ANSWER=no). The skeleton density does not enter the solution at all, so there is no inertia term to ring. Two guardrails 4C raises itself are pinned alongside: TRANSIENT_TERMS 'all' beside a stationary fluid is refused with the fix named — "Invalid option for stationary fluid! Set 'TRANSIENT_TERMS' in section POROELASTICITY DYNAMIC to 'none'!" from poroelast/4C_poroelast_base.cpp line 215 — and switching only the structure to OneStepTheta is refused with 'porous media problem is limited in functionality (only one-step-theta scheme, stationary and (af)genalpha case possible)', because the structure and porofluid integrators must be paired. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Invalid option for stationary fluid! Set 'TRANSIENT_TERMS' in section POROELASTICITY DYNAMIC to 'none'!
porous media problem is limited in functionality (only one-step-theta scheme, stationary and (af)genalpha case possible)

_mutation.note: stop varying the solid density, which is the whole measurement. HEAVY_DECK_IS_1000X drops to 0, the two arms become the same deck, and the fixture loses the only comparison that shows inertia is absent — so it must go red.
remove the pathology from the transient arm: leave TRANSIENT_TERMS at none. The stationary-fluid refusal vanishes, that arm exits 0, and the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the integrator-pairing arm: leave the structure on Statics beside the stationary fluid. The pairing refusal vanishes and the fixture must go red.
